# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Servant

## History

Mabel Colby served as a household maid at Blackwood Manor. Her mysterious death and the strange circumstances surrounding her passing became a focal point of suspicion and investigation for those uncovering the dark secrets of the manor.
